SchemaDataDesignerPage.InfoBlockText2: The installation type determines the method of adding the application data upon the installation of the package.
SchemaDataDesignerPage.InfoBlockText3: • Installation — data is added during the first installation of the package and is updated with the package updates. New records are always added. Existing records are updated only if the “Forced update” checkbox is selected on the “Columns setting” tab. This is the default and most flexible type.
SchemaDataDesignerPage.InfoBlockText4: • Update existing — deprecated type. We recommend using the Installation type instead because this type has similar behaviour.
SchemaDataDesignerPage.InfoBlockText5: • Initial package installation — data is added only during the first installation of the package. Data is not updated or added during subsequent package updates.
SchemaDataDesignerPage.InfoBlockText6: • Initial data installation — data binding is installed during the first package installation or subsequent updates only if the same binding does not already exist. Use this type to avoid unintended overwrites.

Notes.Text:
Url to get leads – a Creatio URL that will receive the leads from the connected ad accounts.The Creatio website must be accessible to be able to receive the incoming requests. If you use a proxy server, specify the proxy URL instead of the Creatio URL. If your Creatio instance is a part of a restricted access network, whitelist the lead generation service IPs.

Role for receiving notifications — Creatio will notify the users within this role in case of any failures, such as errors when connecting ad accounts or creating leads.

The “Connection” tab displays the list of ad accounts and pages connected to Creatio. The list includes the current connection statuses on page, account, and token levels. You can manage the connections, for example, delete or reset them.

The “Logs” tab displays the lead generation functionality change log.
